SELECT "user_id"
FROM "parity_shop"."users"
WHERE "user_id" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 10000

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "product_id", "ordered_at"
FROM TMP
JOIN "parity_shop"."orders"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ordered_at" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ordered_at" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ordered_at", "order_id", "product_id"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "age", CAST("country" AS text), "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "parity_shop"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, sampled.*
FROM TMP
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "product_id", "quantity", "ordered_at",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "ordered_at" DESC, "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__
  FROM "parity_shop"."orders"
  WHERE "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
    AND "ordered_at" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
  ORDER BY "ordered_at" DESC, "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "user_id"
  LIMIT 32
) AS sampled ON TRUE
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__, __KUMO_ROW__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "product_id", "category", "price",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY CAST("category" AS text), "price", "product_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "parity_shop"."products"
    ON "product_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__
